message: ACE inhibitor/ARB refill with serum potassium > 5.5 mmol/L (or no recent potassium). Pharmacist review before renewal.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Figure 32 (actions for potassium >5.5 mmol/l); lisinopril label 5.5, losartan label 5.4

message: ACE inhibitor/ARB refill with eGFR < 15 mL/min/1.73 m2 (or no recent eGFR). Prescriber review before renewal.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Practice Point 3.6.5

message: ACE inhibitor/ARB refill and pregnancy not excluded. Boxed warning (fetal toxicity). Hold for prescriber.
source: Lisinopril label, Boxed Warning and 5.1; losartan (Cozaar) label, Boxed Warning and 5.1

message: ACE inhibitor refill with recorded ACE inhibitor allergy or angioedema.
source: Lisinopril label, 4 Contraindications

message: ARB refill with recorded ARB hypersensitivity.
source: Losartan (Cozaar) label, 4 Contraindications

message: Spironolactone refill with potassium > 5.5 mmol/L (or no potassium in 120 days). Hold for pharmacist.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Figure 26 (hold MRA at K+ >5.5; applicable to steroidal MRA); spironolactone label 5.1

message: Spironolactone refill, age >= 65, CrCl < 30 mL/min. Beers 2023: avoid.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6 (spironolactone, CrCl <30: avoid)

message: Thiazide refill with recorded sulfonamide-derived drug hypersensitivity.
source: Hydrochlorothiazide label, Contraindications

message: Metformin refill with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2: contraindicated; discontinue per label.
source: Metformin label, 2.4 and 4 Contraindications

message: Metformin refill with eGFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2: assess benefit and risk of continuing.
source: Metformin label, 2.4

message: Empagliflozin refill with eGFR < 30: not recommended for glycemic control. Pharmacist to confirm indication (heart failure or CKD use may continue).
source: Jardiance label, 1 Indications (limitations of use) and 2.1; KDIGO 2024 Practice Point 3.7.1

message: Dapagliflozin refill with eGFR < 45: not recommended for glycemic control. Pharmacist to confirm indication (heart failure or CKD use may continue).
source: Farxiga label, 1 Indications (limitations of use) and 2.2; KDIGO 2024 Practice Point 3.7.1

message: Glyburide refill in an adult >= 65: avoid (long-acting sulfonylurea).
source: ADA Standards of Care 2025, Section 13 (Pharmacologic Therapy, Insulin Secretagogues); AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2

message: Sulfonylurea refill in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid unless substantial barriers to safer agents; prefer short-acting. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (sulfonylureas)

message: Sulfonylurea refill with documented hypoglycemia since last review. Consider deintensification; prescriber review.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2025, Recommendations 13.4 and 13.16a; glipizide label, Precautions (Hypoglycemia)

message: Sulfonylurea refill with recorded sulfonylurea hypersensitivity.
source: Glipizide label, Contraindications

message: Statin refill and pregnancy not excluded. Label: discontinue when pregnancy is recognized. Hold for prescriber.
source: Atorvastatin (Lipitor) label 8.1; simvastatin label 8.1

message: Statin refill with recorded statin hypersensitivity.
source: Atorvastatin (Lipitor) label, 4 Contraindications

message: Lithium refill with serum lithium > 1.2 mEq/L (or none in 60 days). Toxicity range is close to therapeutic range. Pharmacist review.
source: Lithium carbonate ER label, Warnings and Dosage and Administration (desirable 0.6 to 1.2 mEq/L; toxic >=1.5 mEq/L)

message: Lithium refill with serum lithium >= 1.5 mEq/L (label toxic range). Route to the ordering clinician now; do not renew in the lane.
source: Lithium carbonate ER label, Warnings (toxic concentrations >=1.5 mEq/L)

message: Warfarin refill: always routes to the anticoagulation pharmacist (narrow therapeutic range; INR-guided dosing).
source: Warfarin label, 2.4 Monitoring to Achieve Optimal Anticoagulation

message: Rivaroxaban refill with CrCl < 15 mL/min: label says avoid use (DVT/PE indications).
source: Xarelto label, 2.1 Table 1; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6

message: Rivaroxaban refill with CrCl <= 50 mL/min: pharmacist verifies indication-specific dose (NVAF: 15 mg daily at CrCl <= 50).
source: Xarelto label, 2.1 Table 1; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6

message: Dabigatran refill with CrCl < 30 mL/min: pharmacist verifies dose (NVAF 75 mg BID at CrCl 15-30; no recommendation < 15).
source: Dabigatran etexilate label, 2.2; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6

condition: age_ge_80 OR weight_le_60_kg; age_ge_80 OR lab:creatinine_ge_1_5; weight_le_60_kg OR lab:creatinine_ge_1_5; rx_class:apixaban
message: Apixaban refill: patient meets >= 2 of age >= 80, weight <= 60 kg, creatinine >= 1.5 mg/dL. Pharmacist verifies the NVAF dose is 2.5 mg BID.
source: Eliquis label, 2.1 (NVAF dose reduction criteria)

message: Valproate refill and pregnancy not excluded. Boxed warning (fetal risk); contraindicated for migraine prophylaxis in pregnancy. Hold for prescriber.
source: Divalproex sodium DR label, Boxed Warning, 1.4 and 4 Contraindications

message: Methotrexate refill and pregnancy not excluded. Contraindicated in pregnancy for non-neoplastic disease. Hold for prescriber.
source: Methotrexate tablets label, Boxed Warning (embryo-fetal toxicity)

message: Topiramate refill and pregnancy not excluded (fetal toxicity: oral clefts). Prescriber review.
source: Topiramate label, 5.7 Fetal Toxicity

message: Isotretinoin is dispensed only under the iPLEDGE REMS. Out of the refill lane.
source: Isotretinoin (Zenatane) label, 5.2 iPLEDGE REMS

message: Controlled substance (Schedule II-V, e.g. ADHD stimulants, pregabalin). Out of the refill lane; route to the prescriber.
source: 21 CFR 1306.12(a) (Schedule II refills prohibited); 21 CFR 1306.22(a) (Schedule III-IV refill limits); pregabalin label 9.1 (Schedule V)

message: NSAID refill, age >= 65, CrCl < 30 mL/min. Beers 2023: avoid.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6 (NSAIDs, CrCl <30: avoid)

message: Chronic NSAID refill, age >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid chronic use unless alternatives fail and a gastroprotective agent is used. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (non-COX-2-selective NSAIDs, oral)

message: NSAID refill with recorded NSAID or aspirin allergic-type reaction.
source: Ibuprofen label, Contraindications; naproxen DR label, 4 Contraindications

message: Beta-blocker, diltiazem/verapamil, or amiodarone refill with second- or third-degree AV block or sick sinus syndrome and no functioning pacemaker. Label contraindication; prescriber review.
source: Metoprolol succinate ER label 4; Coreg label 4; Tenormin label, Contraindications; propranolol label, Contraindications; Cardizem CD label, Contraindications; verapamil ER label, Contraindications; amiodarone label 4

message: Propranolol or carvedilol refill with asthma on the problem list. Label contraindication (bronchial asthma); prescriber review.
source: Propranolol label, Contraindications (bronchial asthma); Coreg label 4 (bronchial asthma or related bronchospastic conditions)

message: Atenolol refill with CrCl <= 35 mL/min/1.73 m2. Pharmacist verifies the daily dose is <= 50 mg (<= 25 mg if CrCl < 15).
source: Tenormin label, Dosage and Administration (Elderly Patients or Patients with Renal Impairment, maximum dosage table)

message: Diltiazem or verapamil refill with systolic BP < 90 mm Hg. Label contraindication (hypotension); prescriber review.
source: Cardizem CD label, Contraindications (hypotension, less than 90 mm Hg systolic); verapamil ER label, Contraindications (systolic pressure less than 90 mm Hg)

message: Diltiazem or verapamil refill with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Beers 2023: avoid in HFrEF; verapamil label: contraindicated in severe LV dysfunction. Prescriber review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 3 (heart failure: avoid non-DHP CCBs in HFrEF); verapamil ER label, Contraindications; Cardizem CD label, Warnings (Congestive Heart Failure)

message: Clonidine refill after the previous supply ran out. Sudden cessation can cause rebound hypertension. Pharmacist checks BP and withdrawal symptoms before renewal.
source: Clonidine hydrochloride tablet label, Warnings (Withdrawal)

message: Clonidine refill for hypertension in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid as first-line antihypertensive. Pharmacist review; do not stop abruptly.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (central alpha-agonists for hypertension)

message: Hydralazine refill with new joint pain, fever, rash, or other lupus-like symptoms. Label: discontinue unless benefit outweighs risk. Route to the prescriber.
source: Hydralazine hydrochloride tablet label, Warnings (systemic lupus erythematosus-like picture)

message: Hydralazine refill with coronary artery disease or rheumatic mitral valve disease (label contraindications). Pharmacist confirms the prescriber accepted this.
source: Hydralazine hydrochloride tablet label, Contraindications

message: Nitrate refill with an active PDE5 inhibitor (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) or riociguat. Label contraindication (severe hypotension).
source: Isosorbide mononitrate tablet label (Coupler), Contraindications

message: GLP-1 RA refill with personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2. Label contraindication; prescriber review.
source: Ozempic label 4; Trulicity label 4; Victoza label 4

message: GLP-1 RA or DPP-4 inhibitor refill with persistent severe abdominal pain or suspected pancreatitis. Label: discontinue if suspected. Route to the prescriber.
source: Ozempic label 5.2; Trulicity label 5.2; Victoza label 5.2; Januvia label 5.1; saxagliptin label 5.1; Tradjenta label 5.1; Nesina label 5.1

message: Semaglutide refill and pregnancy not excluded or planned. Label: discontinue at least 2 months before a planned pregnancy. Prescriber review.
source: Ozempic label 8.3 (Females and Males of Reproductive Potential)

message: Sitagliptin refill with eGFR < 45: pharmacist verifies dose (50 mg daily at eGFR 30 to < 45; 25 mg daily at < 30).
source: Januvia label 2.2

message: Saxagliptin refill with eGFR < 45: pharmacist verifies dose is 2.5 mg daily.
source: Saxagliptin tablet label (Glenmark) 2.2

message: Saxagliptin or alogliptin refill with heart failure. Label warning (hospitalization for heart failure); pharmacist review.
source: Saxagliptin tablet label (Glenmark) 5.2; Nesina label 5.2

message: Basal insulin refill with documented hypoglycemia since last review. Refill only; the dose is not changed in this lane. Pharmacist review for deintensification.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 6.6 and 6.10; Lantus label 5.3

message: Insulin or sulfonylurea refill with level 2 (< 54 mg/dL) or level 3 hypoglycemia since last review. ADA: reevaluate the treatment plan. Route to the prescriber.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 6.19 and Hypoglycemia section (level definitions)

message: Pioglitazone refill with symptomatic heart failure. Boxed warning; Beers 2023: avoid in symptomatic heart failure. Prescriber review.
source: Actos label, Boxed Warning and 4; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 3 (heart failure)

message: Pioglitazone refill with active bladder cancer. Label: do not use. Prescriber review.
source: Actos label 5.4

message: Allopurinol refill with a new skin rash. Label: discontinue at the first appearance of rash. Route to the prescriber.
source: Allopurinol tablet label (AvPAK) 5.1

message: Allopurinol refill with azathioprine or mercaptopurine. Label: reduce the azathioprine or mercaptopurine dose (myelosuppression). Pharmacist review.
source: Allopurinol tablet label (AvPAK) 7 (Mercaptopurine or Azathioprine)

message: Febuxostat refill with azathioprine or mercaptopurine. Label contraindication.
source: Uloric label 4

message: Febuxostat refill with established cardiovascular disease. Boxed warning (CV death); use only after allopurinol failure or intolerance. Pharmacist confirms.
source: Uloric label, Boxed Warning and 1

message: Febuxostat > 40 mg daily with CrCl < 30 mL/min. Label limits the dose to 40 mg daily in severe renal impairment.
source: Uloric label 2.2 and 8.6

message: Single-agent LABA (salmeterol) refill with asthma. Label: contraindicated without a concomitant ICS. Pharmacist confirms an active ICS.
source: Serevent Diskus label 4

message: Asthma controller refill with increasing short-acting beta2-agonist use. Label: marker of deteriorating asthma; needs immediate reevaluation. Route to the prescriber.
source: Advair HFA label 5.2; Serevent Diskus label 5.2

message: Tiotropium refill with recorded tiotropium or ipratropium hypersensitivity.
source: Spiriva HandiHaler label 4

message: Montelukast refill with new mood, behavior, sleep, or suicidal symptoms. Boxed warning: discontinue. Route to the prescriber.
source: Singulair label, Boxed Warning and 5.1

condition: rx_class:ssri OR rx_class:snri OR rx_class:mirtazapine OR rx_class:trazodone OR rx_class:bupropion; med:maoi_within_14_days
message: Antidepressant refill with an MAOI taken now or within 14 days. Label contraindication (serotonin syndrome; hypertensive reaction with bupropion).
source: Zoloft label 4; Lexapro label 4; Celexa label 4; Prozac label 4; Paxil CR label 4; duloxetine DR label 4; venlafaxine ER label 4; Remeron label 4; trazodone label 4; Wellbutrin XL label 4

message: SSRI or SNRI refill with an active anticoagulant. Labels: added bleeding risk. Beers 2023: avoid warfarin with SSRIs when possible; monitor INR. Pharmacist review.
source: Zoloft label 5.3; Celexa label 5.4; venlafaxine ER label 5.4; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 5 (warfarin and SSRIs)

condition: rx_class:ssri OR rx_class:snri OR rx_class:mirtazapine OR rx_class:carbamazepine; age_ge_65; ref:sodium_below_lln
message: SSRI, SNRI, mirtazapine, or carbamazepine refill, age >= 65, last sodium below the laboratory reference range. Beers 2023: SIADH/hyponatremia risk. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 4 (SIADH or hyponatremia); Zoloft label 5.8; Celexa label 5.9; venlafaxine ER label 5.9; Remeron label 5.12

message: Citalopram > 20 mg daily in a patient older than 60. Label maximum is 20 mg daily (QT prolongation). Pharmacist review.
source: Celexa label 2 and Highlights (maximum 20 mg once daily for patients greater than 60 years of age)

message: Duloxetine refill with CrCl < 30 mL/min. Label and Beers 2023: avoid. Prescriber review.
source: Duloxetine DR label 8.10 (avoid at GFR <30 mL/min); AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6

message: Strongly anticholinergic antidepressant (e.g. paroxetine, amitriptyline, nortriptyline) refill in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (antidepressants with strong anticholinergic activity)

message: Bupropion refill with a seizure disorder. Label contraindication.
source: Wellbutrin XL label 4

message: Bupropion refill with current or prior bulimia or anorexia nervosa. Label contraindication (seizure risk).
source: Wellbutrin XL label 4

message: Bupropion > 450 mg daily. Label: seizure risk is dose related; limit to 450 mg daily.
source: Wellbutrin XL label, Highlights and 5.3

message: Gabapentin refill with CrCl < 60 mL/min. Pharmacist verifies the daily dose against the label renal table.
source: Neurontin label 2, Table 1; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6

message: Gabapentin or pregabalin refill with an active opioid. Label warning (respiratory depression); Beers 2023: avoid. Pharmacist review.
source: Neurontin label 5.8; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 5 (opioids and gabapentinoids)

message: First-generation antihistamine (e.g. hydroxyzine, diphenhydramine) refill in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (first-generation antihistamines)

message: Strongly anticholinergic drug refill, age >= 65, with dementia, cognitive impairment, or delirium risk. Beers 2023: avoid. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 3 (delirium; dementia or cognitive impairment) and Table 7

message: Strongly anticholinergic drug refill, age >= 65, with another strongly anticholinergic drug active. Beers 2023: avoid; minimize the number. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 5 (anticholinergic plus anticholinergic) and Table 7

message: PPI scheduled for > 8 weeks in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid unless high risk or demonstrated need. Pharmacist confirms the indication.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (proton-pump inhibitors)

message: Famotidine refill with CrCl < 60 mL/min. Pharmacist verifies the dose against the label renal table.
source: Famotidine tablet label 2.2 (dosage adjustment at creatinine clearance less than 60 mL/min); AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6 (CrCl <50)

message: Alendronate refill with CrCl < 35 mL/min. Label: not recommended. Prescriber review.
source: Alendronate sodium tablet label 5.6 and 8.6

message: Risedronate refill with CrCl < 30 mL/min. Label: not recommended. Prescriber review.
source: Risedronate sodium DR label 5.7 and 8.6

condition: rx_class:alendronate OR rx_class:risedronate; ref:calcium_below_lln OR sx:cannot_stay_upright_30_min
message: Oral bisphosphonate refill with low calcium or inability to stay upright for 30 minutes. Label contraindications; prescriber review.
source: Alendronate sodium tablet label 4; risedronate sodium DR label 4

message: Tamsulosin refill with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (e.g. ketoconazole). Label: should not be used together.
source: Flomax label 2 and 5.2

message: Tamsulosin refill with recorded sulfa allergy. Label: caution if the allergy was serious or life-threatening. Pharmacist checks severity.
source: Flomax label 5.6

message: Finasteride refill for a patient who is or may be pregnant. Label contraindication. Hold for prescriber.
source: Proscar label 4

message: Carbamazepine refill and pregnancy not excluded (fetal harm, spina bifida). Prescriber review.
source: Tegretol label, Warnings (Usage in Pregnancy)

message: Carbamazepine refill with nefazodone (contraindicated) or an MAOI within 14 days (not recommended).
source: Tegretol label, Contraindications

message: Lamotrigine refill with a new rash. Boxed warning: discontinue at the first sign of rash unless clearly not drug related. Route to the prescriber.
source: Lamictal label, Boxed Warning and 5.1

message: Lamotrigine refill after the previous supply ran out. If stopped for more than 5 half-lives, the label requires re-titration from the initial dose. Pharmacist review.
source: Lamictal label 2.1 (restarting therapy)

message: Levetiracetam refill with CrCl <= 80 mL/min/1.73 m2. Pharmacist verifies the dose against the label renal table.
source: Keppra label 2, Table 1; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 6 (CrCl <=80: reduce dose)

message: Amiodarone refill with ALT > 3 times the upper limit of normal. Label: discontinue or reduce dose. Prescriber review.
source: Amiodarone hydrochloride tablet label, Boxed Warning and 5.3 (Hepatic Injury)

message: Amiodarone refill with warfarin, age >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid when possible; monitor INR closely. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 5 (warfarin and amiodarone)

message: Digoxin refill with serum digoxin > 2 ng/mL (or no recent level). Label: toxicity without added benefit. Pharmacist review.
source: Digoxin tablet label (Amneal) 2.5 and 10.1 (levels above 2 ng/mL)

message: Digoxin > 0.125 mg daily in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid dosages > 0.125 mg/day for AF or heart failure. Pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (digoxin)

message: Antihypertensive titration requested but mean BP is at or below the documented goal (or no goal is documented). Hold the increase.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 10.3, 10.4, 10.6, and 13.9

message: Antihypertensive titration requested on fewer than two readings or one occasion. Hold until BP is confirmed with repeat readings.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 10.1 (average of two or more measurements on two or more occasions) and 10.6 (confirmed office-based blood pressure)

message: Antihypertensive titration requested with symptomatic hypotension. Do not increase; route to the ordering clinician (dose reduction may be needed).
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Practice Point 3.6.5; ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 13.9 (relaxed goal for high risk of adverse effects)

message: Diltiazem or verapamil increase requested with systolic BP < 90 mm Hg. Label contraindication; hold.
source: Cardizem CD label, Contraindications; verapamil ER label, Contraindications

message: ACE inhibitor/ARB increase requested with potassium > 5.5 mmol/L (or no potassium in 28 days). Hold.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Figure 32 (potassium >5.5 mmol/l) and Practice Point 3.6.2

message: ACE inhibitor/ARB increase requested after creatinine rose > 30% within 4 weeks of the last start or increase. Hold; prescriber review.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Practice Point 3.6.4

message: ACE inhibitor/ARB increase requested but creatinine and potassium were not checked 2 to 4 weeks after the last change. Hold and order the labs.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Practice Point 3.6.2; ADA Standards of Care 2026, Section 10 text (monitor creatinine and potassium after uptitration)

condition: titrate:ace_inhibitor OR titrate:arb; med:ace_inhibitor OR med:arb OR med:arni OR med:direct_renin_inhibitor
message: Requested ACE inhibitor/ARB titration or add-on would combine RAS inhibitors. ADA and KDIGO: avoid. Block.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 10.9; KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Recommendation 3.6.4; AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 5

condition: titrate:ace_inhibitor OR titrate:arb OR titrate:mra; preg:possible
message: ACE inhibitor, ARB, or MRA titration requested and pregnancy not excluded. ADA: avoid without reliable contraception. Hold for prescriber.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 10.12; lisinopril and Cozaar labels, Boxed Warning

message: MRA increase requested with potassium > 4.8 mmol/L (or none in 28 days). KDIGO protocol increases the dose only at K+ <= 4.8. Hold.
source: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Figure 26 (increase dose at K+ <=4.8 mmol/l; legend: could be used for steroidal MRA)

message: Thiazide or loop diuretic increase requested with potassium below the laboratory reference range. Hold; pharmacist review.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 10.11 (monitor for hypokalemia with diuretics)

message: Glucose-lowering titration requested but A1C is at or below the documented goal (or no goal is documented). Hold the increase.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 6.3a, 6.5, 6.8, and 13.7a-c

message: Glucose-lowering titration requested after level 2 or 3 hypoglycemia. ADA: reevaluate the treatment plan. Route to the ordering clinician.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 6.19 and Table 6.4 (level definitions)

message: Insulin or sulfonylurea increase requested with a glucose < 70 mg/dL since the last change. Hold; consider deintensification.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 6.3c, 6.6, and 6.13; Hypoglycemia section (level 1 definition)

message: Basal insulin increase requested with a fasting glucose < 80 mg/dL (below the ADA preprandial goal range) since the last change. Hold.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Table 6.3 (preprandial capillary plasma glucose 80-130 mg/dL)

message: Basal insulin increase requested with signs of overbasalization. ADA: reevaluate rather than increase basal insulin. Hold; pharmacist review.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendation 9.26

message: Insulin or sulfonylurea increase requested for a person at high risk for hypoglycemia. ADA: deintensify or switch class. Hold; pharmacist review.
source: ADA Standards of Care 2026, Recommendations 6.6 and 13.14a; Table 6.5

message: Sulfonylurea increase requested in an adult >= 65. Beers 2023: avoid unless substantial barriers to safer agents. Hold; pharmacist review.
source: AGS Beers Criteria 2023, Table 2 (sulfonylureas)

message: Semaglutide or dulaglutide increase requested less than 4 weeks after the current dose started. Label escalation interval is at least 4 weeks. Hold.
source: Ozempic label 2.2; Trulicity label 2.1

message: Liraglutide increase requested less than 1 week after the current dose started. Label escalation interval is at least one week. Hold.
source: Victoza label 2.1

message: Pioglitazone increase requested with new edema, rapid weight gain, or dyspnea. Boxed warning (heart failure). Route to the ordering clinician.
source: Actos label, Boxed Warning (monitor after initiation and after dose increases)

message: CHC renewal, age >= 35, smokes >= 15 cigarettes/day. U.S. MEC category 4. Route to the ordering clinician for a different method.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Smoking, b.ii)

condition: rx_class:chc; bp:sbp_ge_160 OR bp:dbp_ge_100 OR dx:vascular_disease
message: CHC renewal with BP >= 160/100 mm Hg or hypertension with vascular disease. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Hypertension, b.ii and c)

message: CHC renewal with migraine with aura. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Headaches, b.ii)

message: CHC renewal with current or past DVT/PE. U.S. MEC category 3 (lower recurrence risk or therapeutic anticoagulation) or 4 (higher recurrence risk). Route to the ordering clinician.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Deep venous thrombosis/Pulmonary embolism, a-c)

message: CHC renewal with known thrombophilia (e.g. factor V Leiden, antiphospholipid syndrome). U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Thrombophilia)

message: CHC renewal < 21 days postpartum. U.S. MEC category 4 (breastfeeding or not).
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Breastfeeding, a; Postpartum [nonbreastfeeding], a)

message: CHC renewal with current or past ischemic heart disease or stroke. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Current and history of ischemic heart disease; Stroke)

message: CHC renewal with complicated valvular heart disease (pulmonary hypertension, atrial fibrillation risk, or past subacute bacterial endocarditis). U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Valvular heart disease, b)

message: CHC renewal with peripartum cardiomyopathy. U.S. MEC category 4 (< 6 months, or NYHA III-IV) or 3 (>= 6 months, NYHA I-II).
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Peripartum cardiomyopathy)

message: CHC renewal with diabetes and nephropathy, retinopathy, neuropathy, other vascular disease, or > 20 years duration. U.S. MEC category 3/4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Diabetes, c and d)

message: CHC renewal with multiple ASCVD risk factors (e.g. older age, smoking, diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia). U.S. MEC category 3/4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Multiple risk factors for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease)

message: CHC renewal around major surgery with prolonged immobilization. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Surgery, b.ii)

condition: rx_class:chc; dx:decompensated_cirrhosis OR dx:hepatocellular_adenoma OR dx:hepatocellular_carcinoma
message: CHC renewal with decompensated cirrhosis, hepatocellular adenoma, or hepatocellular carcinoma. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Cirrhosis, b; Liver tumors, a.ii and b)

message: CHC renewal with SLE and positive or unknown antiphospholipid antibodies. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Systemic lupus erythematosus, a)

message: CHC renewal with CKD and current nephrotic syndrome, hemodialysis, or peritoneal dialysis. U.S. MEC category 4.
source: U.S. MEC 2024, Table D1 (Chronic kidney disease, a-c)
